title: An AI trading agent that shows you why it makes every trade, no coding needed (free open beta)
author: TradeyAI-R
selftext:
Most people we talk to have the same problem. They have trading ideas, but turning them into an automated bot means learning to code. And the AI trading bots that skip the coding are a black box. A trade opens, money moves, and nobody can tell you why.

We hit this ourselves. Our first version let the LLM trade on its own, and it made different decisions in the same situation every time. So we rebuilt TradeyAI around one idea: you should always know why your agent made a trade.

**Here's how it works:**

**No code:** Describe your idea in plain language, or copy a built-in strategy in one click and adjust it later. The AI turns it into clear entry and exit rules.

**Full transparency:** Once your strategy is set, the rules make the calls, not the LLM. Every decision shows a checklist of each condition with the exact numbers, like "RSI 28.86 vs threshold 30, met." Whether it enters, exits, or stays out, you see why.

**Test before you trust:** Backtest on historical data, then paper trade with simulated funds in live markets before risking real money.

**Learn as you go:** Chat with your agent to ask why it took a trade, what an indicator means, or how to tweak your settings.

Web platform. Trades crypto and onchain US stocks. No credit card, no exchange account needed. You only connect your Binance account when you're ready to trade live.

Free during open beta: [tradeyai.io](https://tradeyai.io/go/62sw9xxy)

AI won't hand you a winning strategy. The edge still comes from your ideas. TradeyAI helps you build, test, and understand them without code.

Tell us what's confusing or missing. We read every comment.
